# fact-wcag-focus-contrast (full)

**Statement**: Focus ring contrast must be ≥ 3:1 against adjacent colors.

**Confidence**: proven
**Evidence**: W3C WCAG 2.2 SC 2.4.11

## Details

The focus indicator (focus ring) surrounding a focused UI component must maintain
a contrast ratio of at least 3:1 between the focused and unfocused presentation.

## Source
- https://www.w3.org/WAI/WCAG22/Understanding/focus-not-obscured-enhanced
